description: Synthetic building performance data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Fazel Khayatian (Empa). A dataset of uncertainty-infused synthetic building performance profiles as hallucinated by a generative adversarial network (GAN). This dataset includes both the original building performance data, as well as 50 synthetic performance scenarios that are generated by a GAN. Further details on the method and codes can be found here: https://github.com/Khayatian/seer. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
